answer: Collateralized vouching makes each extra identity pay a 0.125 ETH bond its voucher loses on a fake; a farm running N fakes pays N×0.125 ETH, unshareable because each bond locks to one vouchee, slashed jointly with its voucher. Newcomers climb the terrace only after a member stakes on them, and anyone can challenge the profile in a Kleros court. A 1,000-wallet farm dies by joint-slash check at $280,000: each fake needs 0.125 ETH at $2,238, its voucher loses the same stake, and the spiral collapses once one grove of challengers flags it.
